scope.v0_target: Desk/lab-scale display characterization rig around a replaceable complete commercial monitor
out_of_scope_v0: Claims of an open commercial display panel or controller
Micro-LED, OLEDoS, or high-resolution TFT fabrication
Optical certification without suitable instrument calibration
scope.claim_ceiling: Architecture specification only; no physical prototype, build-ready BOM, performance result, or qualification is claimed.

safety_boundary.external_supply_policy: Use a certified external supply appropriate to the selected device.
safety_boundary.interlock_policy: No physical system may be promoted to build-ready until electrical review and safe measurement topology are documented.

hardware_design.note: Confirm before first hardware design release; third-party files retain their original license.

datasets.note: Select based on provenance, instrument terms, participant/privacy conditions, and third-party rights.

modules.name: Test-pattern host and signal source
modules.role: Generate a deterministic, revisioned workload and deliver it through an available video output.
selection_requirements: Record host GPU, driver, OS, output mode, signal format and timing path.
Pin exact pattern and workload identities.
Do not treat render time as end-to-end display latency.
modules.substitute_policy: Record equivalent supported output modes and requalify workload timing.

modules.name: Display under test
modules.role: Replaceable complete monitor for V0; a panel/controller module is a later stage.
selection_requirements: Exact manufacturer, model, hardware revision and firmware if available.
Supported modes, input settings, OSD state, warm-up and image APL.
Document whether power is measured at external DC input or AC wall input.
modules.substitute_policy: Any substitute becomes a new device configuration and needs a matched baseline.

modules.name: Mechanical carrier, datum and sensor fixture
modules.role: Set repeatable display position, sensor location and measurement geometry.
selection_requirements: A parametric OpenSCAD sensor interface plate has been published under CERN-OHL-S-2.0.
Publish native CAD plus derived manufacturing exports only after rendering and dimensional review.
Document datums, actual sensor mounting dimensions, fasteners, process tolerances, and assembly.
Provide an independent geometry/fit check before build qualification.
modules.substitute_policy: Use common fasteners and printable/machinable parts where the measured tolerance permits.

design_parameters.name: plate_width_mm
design_parameters.notes: Matches current native CAD default; not fit-validated.

design_parameters.name: plate_height_mm
design_parameters.notes: Matches current native CAD default; not fit-validated.

design_parameters.name: plate_thickness_mm
design_parameters.notes: Matches current native CAD default; structural suitability not evaluated.

design_parameters.name: sensor_aperture_d_mm
design_parameters.notes: Datum aperture only; not an optical acceptance aperture.

design_parameters.name: mount_hole_d_mm
design_parameters.notes: Nominal M3 clearance; fastener choice not reviewed.

design_parameters.name: mount_pitch_x_mm
design_parameters.notes: Placeholder mounting grid; actual sensor PCB is not selected.

design_parameters.name: mount_pitch_z_mm
design_parameters.notes: Placeholder mounting grid; actual sensor PCB is not selected.

design_parameters.name: bracket_slot_width_mm
design_parameters.notes: Nominal M5 clearance; bracket is not selected.

design_parameters.name: bracket_slot_length_mm
design_parameters.notes: Placeholder adjustment length; fit not reviewed.

design_parameters.name: bracket_slot_x_mm
design_parameters.notes: Placeholder slot offset; fit not reviewed.

modules.name: Input power measurement
modules.role: Capture energy under a declared accounting boundary.
selection_requirements: Power range, uncertainty/accuracy statement, sample rate and raw export.
Calibration status and timestamp.
Declared DC input or AC wall boundary; never compare different boundaries without normalization.
modules.substitute_policy: Meter substitutions require matched readings and a documented uncertainty comparison.

modules.name: Temperature observation
modules.role: Record relevant ambient and device temperatures without asserting thermal imaging capability.
selection_requirements: Sensor type, location/contact, range, time response and calibration status.
Explicit distinction between ambient, enclosure, heatsink and panel-surface temperatures.
modules.substitute_policy: Substitutions must preserve placement and response assumptions or declare a new test setup.

modules.name: Optical instrument and mount
modules.role: Measure only the optical quantities supported by the chosen calibrated instrument and geometry.
selection_requirements: Instrument identity, calibration record, uncertainty, spectral/photometric capability, ROI and geometry.
Camera-only evidence must not assert absolute luminance or color accuracy without an appropriate validated calibration model.
Unsupported metrics remain NOT_EVALUATED.
modules.substitute_policy: A different instrument or lens changes the measurement profile and requires revalidation.

modules.name: Capture, reducer and canonical report
modules.role: Retain raw observations and produce deterministic derived metrics and explicit metric-level statuses.
selection_requirements: Rust-first implementation and pinned toolchain.
Raw artifacts retained and hashed; derived values can be independently recomputed.
Reject invalid timestamps, missing samples, unknown units, zero denominators and stale/mismatched calibration.
modules.substitute_policy: Alternative reducer must pass an independent known-answer corpus and hostile negatives.

modules.name: Design revision and evidence link
modules.role: Bind as-designed/as-built identity, calibration, inspection, repair, raw artifacts and release disposition.
selection_requirements: Reuse existing Mycelix evidence semantics and manufacturing route/accounting identity.
A receipt must never promote a simulation to physical qualification.
Preserve failed runs, exclusions, repairs and retests.
modules.substitute_policy: No duplicate generic evidence format; extend existing profile only where justified.

measurement_channels.claim_limit: Must specify energy accounting boundary, sampling interval, gaps, integration rule and uncertainty.
Sensor placement and response must be documented; do not infer internal panel temperature from ambient.
No universal optical metric is enabled until instrument, calibration and geometry are selected.
Separate GPU render time, present timing, scanout and measured end-to-end response.

references.title: Open Source Hardware Definition
references.purpose: Scope, modification freedom and editable source principle

references.title: OSHWA hardware licensing guidance
references.purpose: Licenses and distinguishing project-controlled from third-party hardware

references.title: OSHWA documentation guidance
references.purpose: Editable files, BOM, instructions and source documentation

references.title: Display manufacturing route profiles and economics
references.purpose: Reuse existing route, yield, repair and cost accounting ownership

references.title: Antmicro Programmable LED Panel Board
references.purpose: Public KiCad 9.x 10x14 independently controllable LED reference board with RP2040 or iCE40 control and an external trigger; candidate for synchronized latency fixtures after build/part review.

references.title: frameprobe end-to-end display latency reference
references.purpose: Existing photodiode and RP2040 latency measurement design used as an architecture and test-method reference; review exact hardware/software licenses, parts, sampling limits and independent calibration before any reuse.

references.title: ColorHug2 archived hardware design
references.purpose: Historical open colorimeter schematics and board design useful as a reference; archived repository is not evidence of current instrument availability, calibration, or active maintenance.

references.title: Texas Instruments INA226 documentation
references.purpose: Primary source for current/voltage monitor electrical limits, conversion timing, filtering and shunt design; any implementation still requires range selection and calibration against a suitable reference.

references.title: PGenerator+ display pattern generator
references.purpose: Active third-party reference for HDMI SDR/HDR pattern generation and meter-driven validation; verify its dependency, language, supported hardware, licenses and output behavior before choosing interop.

references.title: International Committee for Display Metrology — IDMS
references.purpose: Use the applicable current IDMS display measurement method as the standards-aligned starting point; report edition and adaptations, without reproducing or replacing the standard.

references.title: NIST Measurement Process Characterization handbook — drift
references.purpose: Research anchor for check-standard/control-chart monitoring of slow measurement-response changes. The current ODRH v0.1 algorithm uses fixed guard-band screening only and does not implement these statistical models.

references.title: NIST Measurement Process Characterization handbook — instrument drift bias
references.purpose: Reference for drift effects and the assumptions behind particular drift-elimination designs; ODRH does not presume linear drift or equally spaced correction is valid.

references.title: IEC 62087-7:2018 — methods of measurement for power consumption, computer monitors
references.purpose: Applicable standards reference for mains-powered computer-monitor power measurements within its stated scope; the project protocol records method edition and deviations without reproducing or claiming compliance.

references.title: NIST/SEMATECH Measurement Process Characterization handbook
references.purpose: Reference for check standards, measurement-process stability, repeatability/reproducibility and uncertainty; ODRH control screening remains a limited synthetic method, not a replacement for statistical procedures.
